description:
`jit::output::failure::classify` derives each failure's details and suggestions from the error value, so call sites no longer need to build them.

## Background

`classify(&anyhow::Error) -> JsonError` in `crates/jit/src/output/failure.rs` currently returns only a code and message. The details and suggestions a user sees are built at call sites in `crates/jit/src/main.rs`: `gate_pass_json_error` for `GatePassFailed`, `GateNotRequiredError` and `ManualGateAttestationRequiredError`; `JsonError::issue_not_found(id)` although `IssueNotFoundError` carries the id; `JsonError::transition_blocked` for `TransitionBlockedError`; `emit_top_level_json_error` for the `InvalidLabelPatternError` suggestion and `LinkedCheckoutWriteRefusedError` details; `dep_add_batch_json_error` for `DependencyBatchRejectedError`; `refine_id_error` for `AmbiguousIdError`/`InvalidIdPrefixError`; `profile_json_error` for `RepositoryStateError::ProfileTargetConflicts` and the profile not-found suggestion; and the `Commands::Search` arm for `search::SearchError` (`RipgrepNotInstalled` suggestion), which the classifier does not downcast at all. The transposed-argument guard in `GateCommands::Status`, the profile not-found path and `item show`'s not-found path (its `ITEM_NOT_FOUND` is a call-site substitution in `IssueCommands::Show`) have no distinguishing error type, so no type-only classifier can reproduce them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: For each error type listed in the Background, `classify` returns the details and suggestions the corresponding call site builds today.
- [hard] REQ-02: `search::SearchError` is classified by type, to the codes the `Commands::Search` arm chooses today, with the ripgrep-missing suggestion.
- [hard] REQ-03: The transposed `gate status` arguments, a missing profile and a missing item (`show_item` in `crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs` raises an untyped error today) each have a typed error whose classification yields the code, details and suggestions their call sites produce today.
- [hard] REQ-04: Library unit tests in `output/failure.rs` own each derivation, asserting the classified code and the presence and meaning of details and suggestions rather than copied strings.
- [hard] REQ-05: The CLI's observable failures are unchanged; the existing envelope and exit-code suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

Call sites keep their emitters until their command group migrates to a handler. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Derive failure details and suggestions from the error type
